title: fm-cleanup.sh: a worker removes its own worktree and nothing else
acceptance: removes state/worktrees/<task> and the branch's registration, after that task's pull request is merged
refuses any path that does not resolve to a direct child of the repository's own worktree root
refuses a path escaping through .. or through a symlink, with a test for each
refuses the repository root, the main worktree, and a path belonging to another repository
refuses while the pull request is still open, so an unmerged branch is never swept away
is idempotent: cleaning an already-clean task changes nothing and exits 0
every worktree lives under one root inside the repository, so the system stays self-contained
